steal_emoji.name: Steal emojis from chat
steal_emoji.hint: Automatically save market emojis / stickers sent by others into the library and tag them with VLM. Can also be toggled on the plugin page.

zh.name: 偷取聊天表情
zh.hint: 自动收藏他人发送的市场表情/表情包并入库存档，由 VLM 自动打标。也可在插件管理页开关。

capacity.name: Library capacity
capacity.hint: Maximum number of emojis kept in the library. When full, least-used entries are evicted first.

zh.name: 图库容量上限
zh.hint: 图库最多保留的表情包数量，满额后优先淘汰使用最少的。

candidate_count.name: Candidate count
candidate_count.hint: How many candidates are sampled for VLM to choose from on each send_emoji call.

zh.name: 候选数量
zh.hint: 每次 send_emoji 时采样多少张候选表情包给 VLM 挑选。

max_emoji_size_mb.name: Max stolen emoji size (MB)
max_emoji_size_mb.hint: Stolen emojis larger than this are skipped.

zh.name: 偷取单图大小上限（MB）
zh.hint: 超过此大小的表情包不做偷取。

vlm_model.name: Tagging model (vision)
vlm_model.hint: Model used to tag stolen/uploaded emojis (image + text prompt, vision required). Empty = host default VLM.

zh.name: 打标模型（需视觉）
zh.hint: 用于给偷取/上传的表情包打标的模型（图片+文字输入，需要视觉能力）。留空使用系统默认 VLM。

selection_model.name: Selection model (text-only)
selection_model.hint: Model used to pick one emoji from candidate descriptions on send_emoji. Text-only task, no vision needed - any chat model works. Empty = host default LLM.

zh.name: 选图模型（纯文本）
zh.hint: send_emoji 时从候选描述中挑选一张的模型。纯文本任务，无需视觉能力，任意对话模型皆可。留空使用系统默认 LLM。

emotion_tag_info.name: Emotion vocabulary
emotion_tag_info.hint: Emojis are tagged with a fixed vocabulary of 20 emotion labels: 胆怯、无语、调皮、开心、困惑、震惊、傲娇、害羞、温柔、委屈、期待、生气、无辜、撒娇、嫌弃、嘲讽、感谢、安慰、悲伤、欢迎。 The send_emoji tool asks the AI to pick one of them as the emotion keyword.

zh.name: 情绪标签词表
zh.hint: 表情包使用固定 20 类情绪标签打标：胆怯、无语、调皮、开心、困惑、震惊、傲娇、害羞、温柔、委屈、期待、生气、无辜、撒娇、嫌弃、嘲讽、感谢、安慰、悲伤、欢迎。send_emoji 工具让 AI 从中选一个情绪关键词。
